Allyson —

Thanks for the VSQ and the context. Quick technical answers and options so your team can evaluate tradeoffs:

1) SOC 2 / BAA
- We have a SOC 2 Type II report; a copy can be delivered under an NDA.
- We can execute a BAA when PHI is in-scope. Our legal team has a standard BAA template; we are also open to reasonable customer edits for enterprise deals.

2) Retention & immutable archives
- Hosted (standard):
  - Application logs: 90 days (searchable), system traces: 30 days.
  - Snapshots/backups: 365 days default (encrypted at rest).
- Extended retention options:
  - Dedicated or Private deployments: configurable retention and ability to integrate with customer S3 for cold archives.
  - We support export of logs in WORM-friendly formats and can push archival bundles to a customer-owned S3 with object-lock enabled; this is our recommended approach for the 7-year requirement.

3) Delete/erase flows
- Standard hosted deletion is processed asynchronously; deletion requests generate an audit trail. For legal holds, we can pause deletion and preserve snapshots per your retention policy.
- If you require attestable deletion certificates or full-chain proof of destruction, that is typically scoped as an add-on with detailed workflow (we can include in the MSA addendum).

4) Backups and RPO/RTO
- Default hosted RPO: 24 hours; RTO varies by dataset and is documented in our runbook.
- For tighter objectives (sub-hour RPO/RTO), Dedicated pools or colocated Private deployments are recommended.

Next steps we propose (technical):
- Stephanie to map VSQ -> answers and flag items requiring legal addendum (target 12/06).
- Technical sync to review S3 object-lock export option: 30-min call week of 12/07 (Laura to own scheduling).

I attached a short technical appendix for the export workflow and a sample manifest. Happy to adjust based on the VSQ fields you flagged.

Regards,
